oss.title: Open source, open to contributors.
oss.description: These repos across the Crafter Station network are maintained and accepting outside contributors: CLIs, design systems, editor tools, and community infrastructure. Pick one and ship.
oss.reposTitle: Maintained, public, and waiting for your PR.
oss.reposDescription: Live data from GitHub, refreshed daily. Stars and open work update on their own; the list itself is curated by the team.
oss.openIssues: {count, plural, one {1 open issue or PR} other {# open issues + PRs}}
oss.howTitle: Three steps to your first merged PR.
oss.step1Description: Start with whatever you already use. Every repo above ships with the same stack: TypeScript, Bun, and Biome.
oss.step2Description: Look for good-first-issue and help-wanted labels, or open an issue proposing what you want to build before writing code.
oss.step3Description: Small, focused pull requests with conventional commits get reviewed fastest. Maintainers respond in the community if you get stuck.
oss.programTitle: Building open source in LatAm? We want to help.
oss.programDescription: We are shaping a support program for open-source projects from the region: perks from our products like Maca, mentorship from the team, and visibility across the Crafter Station network. Tell us what you are building.
oss.timelineTitle: See how the work moved over time.
oss.timelineDescription: Every public repo on one timeline: when each project moved forward, who committed, and how active it is right now.

timeline.timelineDescription: The main timeline counts only commits from the Crafter team. Each row is one public project, and brighter blocks mean more team commits that week. Open a project to see every contributor and the full GitHub details.

brand.title: Made to be recognized.
brand.description: Download the official Crafter Station logo assets for articles, presentations, event pages, and partner materials.
brand.iconDescription: Use the standalone mark when space is limited or the Crafter Station name already appears nearby.
brand.wordmarkDescription: Use the complete lockup when introducing the brand or when extra context is useful.
brand.standaloneDescription: Use the standalone wordmark when the Crafter Station name needs to lead without the icon.
brand.usageDescription: Keep the logo legible, give it room to breathe, and do not stretch, rotate, recolor, or alter the relationship between the mark and wordmark.
